[Sir](../persons.html#712)
I was obliged to let your letter wait till my return as I could not reply without referring to the book.[^1]
‘The Second Temple’ is an anonymous poem in a collection called the Casket made by Joanna Baillie some 50 years ago
_______________________________________________________________________
Moses
[Cardinal Newman](../persons.html#1084) - in the [Lyra Apostolica](../others.html#92)
_______________________________________________________________________
Seventh Sunday after Trinity-
Keble - [Lyra Innocentium](../others.html#232)
________________________________________________________________________
3d Sunday in Advent
[Mrs Yonge](../persons.html#1606)
________________________________________________________________________
Good Friday
Come to a desert place
Wednesday in holy week
[Professor Anstice](../persons.html#2285)
________________________________________________________________________
22d after Trinity
St John the Evangelist
Epiphany
Whitsunday
from Translations of hymns from the Paris Breviary by the Revd [Isaac Williams](../persons.html#1523)
________________________________________________________________________

yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Horder, who published several anthologies of hymns, had evidently asked CMY to identify the contributors to [The Child\'s Christian Year](../others.html#186), a volume compiled by her mother.
